scene_truth.position_review: Author reports reviewing all frames 165-200; original oriented labels preserved.
scene_truth.box_convention: Author describes a full-person volume, not a tight observed-return box.

selection: Rank admitted components by measured cluster-point count inside the unchanged original oriented label; report all positive alternatives and visually inspect every labelled frame. This is not semantic point truth.
criterion: Complete all authored frames and all recorded confirmed hazards; separate point correspondence, presence, track continuity, localization and hazard attribution. Preserve original IoU threshold. Do not count frame-level obstacle status as person detection.
